them: i wrote walt: 'Dear Walt, i have a list taped inside my closet. it's called PEOPLE I WOULD CALL AT 3 AM. line 1 is my mom. lines 2 through 10 are blank. i don't have a phone number for letters. but i'd like 2 put u on line 2. in pen. is that ok? Regards, Adam.' he wrote back in 6 minutes

he wrote: 'Dear Adam, I am awake at this hour as a rule. A man who is awake at that hour is exactly the man for a list like that. I accept line 2. Regards, Walt.' i wrote WALT on line 2. in pen. my mom saw it from the doorway. she said 'who's walt.' i said 'a mailman.' she said 'ok' and put a waffle in the toaster. i cried a little into the waffle. it was a really good waffle
